'''Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle—Another Beginning''' (Japanese: '''劇場版ポケットモンスター ココ ～もうひとつのはじまり～''' ''Pocket Monsters the Movie: Koko ~ Another Beginning ~'') is a short tie-in {{pkmn|manga}} adaptation of the twenty-third Pokémon movie, ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'', taking place three years before the events of the movie. It is adapted by 水野輝昭 Teruaki Mizuno.
